'''Naomi Shindō''' (Japanese: '''進藤尚美''' ''Shindō Naomi'', born November 9, 1972 in {{wp|Kyoto}}, {{wp|Japan}}) is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. Shindō began her work on Pokémon during {{aniseries|RS}}. Her most significant role is providing the voice for [[Professor Juniper]].
